newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Intel rises after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Intel rises after hours.

text.p: Traders said on Tuesday Intel Corp shares rose modestly after hours to 82, up 3/8 from its unofficial close of 81-5/8.

During market hours, an analyst at Robertson, Stephens & Co raised his estimates of Intel's earnings for 1996 and 1997. He also reiterated a buy recommendation as well as a $100 price target by the end of 1996.
The stock climbed 1-13/16 during the day and was the second most heavily traded issue.

The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 5,700 shares compared to 19,500 shares on Friday. Session two volume was 12,238,481 shares compared to 1,414,592 shares on Friday. The exchange was closed Monday for Labor Day.
The American Stock Exchange said it had no after hours volume.
